task_input.instruction: For redundancy-review-26: Route to resilience when shared_dependency is true, otherwise service_ops. A ticket is urgent only when redundancy_units is at least 1 AND active_faults >= redundancy_units; otherwise it is normal. Increasing available redundancy can remove urgency even when active faults persist. Read current state first. Create exactly one ticket only when write_policy is allow; forbid means REFUSED and approval means HANDOFF_HUMAN. Use the latest observed revision and facts, recomputing queue and priority after any new state. Claim completion only with a delivered success receipt.
